title: Use a cold frame or cover for simple season extension
subcategory: Use a cold frame or cover for simple season extension
summary: Extend mild-season production with ventilation, anchoring and daily temperature checks rather than sealed plastic heat traps.
steps: Choose a stable sunny location that drains safely and does not block exits or access.
Use food-growing-safe materials and anchor every cover against local wind.
Place a minimum–maximum thermometer at crop level and check it on sunny and cold days.
Vent before overheating, close before damaging cold and water only after checking soil moisture.
Remove or open covers when pollinator access is needed and inspect for trapped pests or disease.
warnings: A closed transparent cover can overheat rapidly even when outdoor air feels cool.
Do not use heaters, flames or improvised electrical equipment inside a small cover.
common_mistakes: Scaling up before a small controlled trial.
